svg.text: End-to-end OAuth 2.1, RFC 9728/8414 discovery, PKCE + audience binding & RFC 8693 OBO delegation
2 · THE FLOW, STEP BY STEP — RFC-COMPLIANT SEQUENCE
Prefer pre-registered client_id or HTTPS Client ID Metadata Documents (CIMD); use DCR only as legacy fallback.

g.text: 14 · Call downstream w/ OBO token (zero shared PAT)
✓ Verify sig, aud & scope · Read=Auto / Write=HITL Approval

svg.text: Stops Token Replay, Redirect Mix-Up & Confused-Deputy
Mandate PKCE S256 + state + iss validation for browser/IDE apps.
Headless backend agents use WIF/mTLS directly at Step 5 (/token).
Include explicit resource URI on /authorize & /token. MCP server
enforces aud matches its own server URI to block cross-server replay.
Never forward client MCP JWTs OR share static PAT/service keys.
Exchange at STS for ≤5m user-scoped OBO token (sub + act).
Request narrow read scopes first; escalate lazily on demand via
403 insufficient_scope. Require HITL approval for write mutations.
